[id="register-and-store-ui-fields_{context}"]
= Register and Store UI field reference

[role="_abstract"]
You can use the *Register and Store* form in the {productname-short} dashboard to register a model and store it as an OCI image.
The following tables describe the fields in each section of the form.

[id="model-location-and-storage-fields_{context}"]
== Model location and storage

The *Model location and storage* section determines whether the model is registered with metadata only or registered and stored as an OCI image.

.Model location and storage options
[cols="1,2", options="header"]
|===
|Option
|Description

|*Register*
|Registers model metadata only. Points to an artifact that is already stored in an external location. Use this option when the model is already in OCI format or stored in S3/URI storage.

|*Register and Store*
|Registers model metadata and starts a background Kubernetes Job that copies the model from the source location, packages it as a `ModelCar` OCI image, and pushes it to the OCI registry.
|===

[NOTE]
====
If you register a model catalog model whose source is already an `oci://` URI, the UI selects *Register* mode only because the model is already stored in OCI format.
====

[id="transfer-job-fields_{context}"]
== Model transfer job fields

When you select *Register and Store*, the following fields configure the transfer job.

.Model transfer job fields
[cols="1,1,2", options="header"]
|===
|Field
|Required
|Description

|*Model transfer job name*
|Yes
|A human-readable display name for the background transfer job, for example `Upload granite-7b to Quay`.

|*Edit resource name*
|No
|Click to edit the autogenerated Kubernetes Job resource name. The resource name must be a valid Kubernetes name.

|*Project*
|Yes
|The Kubernetes namespace where the transfer job runs. You can select only projects to which you have access. The UI validates that the selected namespace can access the model registry instance. If access cannot be confirmed, a warning indicates that the namespace might not have connectivity to the model registry. You can still proceed, but the transfer job might fail if the namespace cannot reach the registry. For more information, see xref:registering-model-as-oci-image_{context}[Register and store a model as an OCI image].
|===

[id="model-origin-fields_{context}"]
== Model origin location fields

The *Model origin location* section specifies where the model files are stored.

.Object storage (S3-compatible) fields
[cols="1,1,2", options="header"]
|===
|Field
|Required
|Description

|*Endpoint*
|Yes
|The S3 or MinIO endpoint URL, for example `https://s3.amazonaws.com`.

|*Bucket*
|Yes
|The bucket name that contains the model files, for example `ods-ci-s3`.

|*Region*
|No
|The AWS region, if applicable, for example `us-east-1`.

|*Path*
|Yes
|The prefix or path to the model files in the bucket, for example `/kserve-openvino-test/openvino-example-model`.

|*Access Key ID*
|Yes
|The access key ID for the source S3 bucket.

|*Secret Access Key*
|Yes
|The secret access key for the source S3 bucket.
|===

.URI fields
[cols="1,1,2", options="header"]
|===
|Field
|Required
|Description

|*URI*
|Yes
|A direct URL to the model files. Supported schemes are `https://`, `http://`, and `hf://` (for Hugging Face Hub, which uses `snapshot_download`).
|===

[NOTE]
====
For catalog models, the URI is pre-filled from the catalog source and cannot be changed.
====

[id="model-destination-fields_{context}"]
== Model destination location fields

The *Model destination location* section specifies the OCI registry where the `ModelCar` image is stored.

.OCI destination fields
[cols="1,1,2", options="header"]
|===
|Field
|Required
|Description

|*Registry*
|Yes
|The OCI registry host, for example `quay.io` or your self-hosted registry hostname.

|*URI*
|Yes
|The image reference without a scheme, for example `myorg/granite-7b:v1`.

|*Username*
|Yes
|The username for OCI registry authentication. For Quay robot accounts, use the robot account username in the format `<organization>+<robot_name>`.

|*Password*
|Yes
|The password or token for OCI registry authentication. For Quay robot accounts, use the robot account token. For more information about creating robot accounts, see xref:configuring-quay-for-model-registry_{context}[Configure Red Hat Quay as the OCI storage backend].
|===

[id="model-metadata-fields_{context}"]
== Model metadata fields

The remaining fields capture metadata for the registered model and version.
These fields include the model name, version name, model format, and description.
For more information about registering models, see xref:registering-model-as-oci-image_{context}[Register and store a model as an OCI image].
